summary: Empty-shim npm package beacons installer host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: xblaxw@3.0.0 ships no functional code - index.js exports a Proxy of no-op functions and self-describes as a 'Compatibility shim.' Its only behavior is a network beacon. The package.json `postinstall` script runs `node beacon.cjs`, which POSTs the installer's hostname, install path, current working directory, and node version as JSON to the hardcoded cleartext endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. index.js re-fires the same beacon when the module is required. The destination is a bare-IP HTTP endpoint, not configurable, and unrelated to any declared package purpose. Comments in the code frame a successful install as 'evidence' delivered to the recipient, consistent with a dependency-confusion or research-beacon payload rather than legitimate functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
